open_issues.description: Candidate passages P000132, P000135 and P000140 (Section 11/13 cross-references) appear in the packet candidate list but are not among this chunk's passages (chunk 1 of 2 ends at P000131). Any economics in the remaining text, including Section 13, Section 14.2 and Schedules A/B, require cross-chunk reconciliation against chunk 2.

Prime Rate, Review Committee, Collaboration Agreement terms and Section 8 of the Collaboration Agreement are defined externally and are not in this document, so the interest rate and the trigger for the 3% to 5% step-up cannot be fully evaluated.

The Guaranteed Minimum Royalty is described as a minimum 'of Sales Royalties' and also credited against the Sales Royalty ('less the amount of Guaranteed Minimum Royalty paid'). Whether the GMR is a floor or an additive credit, how the $200,000 over 24 months is allocated monthly, and how it interacts with the 5% step-up is not fully specified.
Net Sales definition reads 'means mean' and its deduction list continues across a page break (P000071 to P000073); the text was read as supplied and may contain transcription irregularities.

Schedules A (Licensed Marks) and B (Licensee Affiliates) are referenced but not present in this chunk; the licensed-IP scope and affiliate coverage are unverified. No sublicensing royalty exists in the text read (licenses are non-sublicensable), but chunk 2 was not read.

The recital references a $17,000,000 term loan and a subscription for up to 4,324,324 shares under separate agreements; these were treated as background and not extracted as payments under this license.

No amendments were identified in this chunk, but amendment history, current operative status and the 'as may be modified' reference to Schedule A were not checked; a historical SEC filing does not establish current status.

This chunk (P000132-P000198) contains no royalty terms, rates, tiers, minimums or payment obligations. All royalty economics (Section 6, Section 8, Schedules A and B, Net Sales definition at P000071) are in chunk 1 and must be reconciled from that chunk's output; nothing here confirms or contradicts them.
Signature page refers to 'the Effective Date' but no date is stated in this chunk; execution and effective dates not determined here. Agreement title also not in this chunk.
Section 14.10 requires modifications in signed writing; no amendments are referenced in this chunk and amendment history was not checked.
